note: Tolerances for evals/gate.py. 'metrics': a gated metric fails only when the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of the paired worsening (new vs reference, paired per (host, case, rep), repetitions averaged per case, CI over cases) is above 'tolerance' in the metric's own unit; worse than tolerance on average with a CI that reaches back inside it is a warning. 'absolute': the one rule without statistics, because any occurrence is a defect: the share of reader-facing runs whose output carries an unresolved marker or placeholder. 'min_cases_for_ci': fewer paired cases than this give no verdict. Tolerances of flesch_reading_ease (5) and sentence_length_cv (0.1) sit above the A/A noise floor measured with `gate.py aa` on v-voice-omp and v-clean-omp (largest per-skill lower CI bound of a pure repetition swap: 4.2 points, 0.083); re-measure when the reference changes.

invented_facts.why: A/A on v-iso-omp (single rep r1 vs r3) gave a CI lower bound of +0.024 per run for ALL; 0.05 clears that floor and still catches the v-clean project-report regression (+0.056)
